case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for being so open about your cost situation. We value the craftsmanship of your foundry team and the trust between our companies, and we take the rise in metalworking wages seriously.

Having reviewed the overall picture, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have put together three options instead:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Each option offers you a longer contract term and with it more planning security for your workforce. Option C also keeps your current payment terms unchanged. We would be glad to hear which one works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your offer of a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable planning security for our foundry workforce. In return for this longer commitment, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.40 while keeping the payment terms at 30 days net. This is a substantial step towards your position, reflecting our dedication to our long-standing partnership. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing the strong relationship between our companies and reaching a mutually beneficial agreement.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving towards us. We are glad the longer contract gives your foundry team the planning security you were looking for.

All three of our options build on that longer term. Option C also keeps your preferred payment terms. Even so, your current price is still too far from where we need to be. We have moved as well and would like to close on one of these:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 47.38; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.00; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.07; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

We are confident one of them works for both sides and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offer and the continued constructive dialogue between our companies. For generations, our family foundry has taken great pride in serving long-standing partners across our region with quality castings. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Building on your Option C, we are prepared to lower our price further to €50.80 per unit while keeping the 30-day payment terms and 24-month contract. This step reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership and the value we place on the planning security provided by the longer term.

Please note that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For clarity, our Angebot consists of a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
